title: O DEVER DE LEMBRAR PARA HUMANIZAR THE DUTY TO REMEMBER IN ORDER TO HUMANIZE
text_snippet: O DEVER DE LEMBRAR PARA HUMANIZAR THE DUTY TO REMEMBER IN ORDER TO HUMANIZE This paper analyzes the impacts on human development of the project of forgetting initiated during Brazil’s dictatorial and contemporary periods by neoliberal rationality, advocating a return to Freirean liberating education as an antidote to violence and the commodification of education. The paper is the result of research conducted in the Doctoral Program in Education (PPGE/UFPB) and of debates held in the classes of the elective course “State and Educational Policy.” The study draws on scholarly references from the field of Memory, such as Halbwachs (2006) and Le Goff (1996), and adopts, as a methodological framework. The indicial paradigma (Ginzburg, 1989), linked to Paulo Freire’s Liberating Pedagogy. This dialogue seeks to understand the consolidation of historical erasure and silencing—structural elements of the Brazilian educational field—from the dictatorship to the present day. The paper argues that the technocracy established during the authoritarian period laid the foundation for neoliberal managerialization, which, under the guise of modernization, undermines the critical dimension of human development. title: OS DESAFIOS DA EDUCAÇÃO FORMAL NAS COMUNIDADES RIBEIRINHAS DO MUNICÍPIO DE ÓBIDOS-PARÁ THE CHALLENGES OF FORMAL EDUCATION IN RIVERSIDE COMMUNITIES IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF ÓBIDOS, PARÁ
text_snippet: OS DESAFIOS DA EDUCAÇÃO FORMAL NAS COMUNIDADES RIBEIRINHAS DO MUNICÍPIO DE ÓBIDOS-PARÁ THE CHALLENGES OF FORMAL EDUCATION IN RIVERSIDE COMMUNITIES IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF ÓBIDOS, PARÁ This article analyzes the challenges of formal education in riverside communities in the municipality of Óbidos, Pará, considering their geographic, social, and cultural specificities. The study aims to investigate the factors that influence access to, permanence in, and quality of education in these locations. This is a qualitative and descriptive study, developed through bibliographic research and fieldwork, including interviews with teachers, students, and community members. The results show that the lack of continuing teacher education, limitations in river transportation, and precarious school infrastructure are the main challenges faced. It is concluded that overcoming these issues depends on the implementation of more effective and contextualized public policies, as well as the appreciation of local knowledge and the development of pedagogical practices aligned with the riverside reality.

title: DESENVOLVIMENTO DO POTENCIAL CRIATIVO NO ENSINO DE GRADUAÇÃO EM ENFERMAGEM DEVELOPMENT OF CREATIVE POTENTIAL IN UNDERGRADUATE NURSING EDUCATION
text_snippet: DESENVOLVIMENTO DO POTENCIAL CRIATIVO NO ENSINO DE GRADUAÇÃO EM ENFERMAGEM DEVELOPMENT OF CREATIVE POTENTIAL IN UNDERGRADUATE NURSING EDUCATION This article aims to analyze faculty perceptions regarding the development of creative potential in nursing education. This is an exploratory-descriptive study with a qualitative approach, conducted with 15 faculty members from an undergraduate nursing program. Data collection was carried out virtually through a structured form applied in September 2025. Data were analyzed using content analysis as proposed by Bardin. The analysis allowed the identification of three thematic categories: (1) Creativity from the faculty perspective; (2) Practices for creative learning; and (3) The ground where creativity flourishes (or fades). The results indicated that creativity is perceived as an important element in health care, enabling nurses to act in complex scenarios without losing sensitivity and the human dimension of care. Creativity emerged as an attribute built through pedagogical relationships and the ways educational processes are organized. It was conceptually recognized as a relevant competence for professional practice; however, its development in undergraduate education still faces limitations related to structural conditions and the persistence of traditional teaching models.

title: AQUILOMBAR O CURRÍCULO AQUILOMBAR THE CURRICULUM
text_snippet: AQUILOMBAR O CURRÍCULO AQUILOMBAR THE CURRICULUM This article analyzes the potential of African technologies and gamification as didactic-pedagogical strategies for constructing an Afro-referenced curriculum within *quilombola* school education in the Amazon region of Amapá. Conducted at a school in the Cria-ú *Quilombo* (Amapá), this qualitative study gathered data through observation and interviews with the pedagogical team; these findings informed the development of didactic-pedagogical proposals for the curriculum subjects of Art, Portuguese Language, History, Geography, and Religious Education. The study adopts a broad understanding of technology—rooted in ancestral knowledge, cultural practices, and Afro-descendant forms of social organization—in dialogue with gamification as an active learning methodology. The results demonstrate that the structural limitations and potentials identified in the research setting guided the creation of contextualized gamified practices, fostering student engagement, strengthening *quilombola* identity, and valuing traditional knowledge within the school curriculum, even in contexts with limited access to digital technologies. title: O PNE (2025-2035) E O PARADIGMA DA EAD THE PNE (2025-2035) AND THE EAD PARADIGM
text_snippet: O PNE (2025-2035) E O PARADIGMA DA EAD THE PNE (2025-2035) AND THE EAD PARADIGM This article critically analyzes the expansion of bachelor’s degrees in Distance Education (EAD) in the context of the new National Education Plan (2025-2035), problematizing the paradigm of the modality against the clash between universalization with quality and formative massification. The central objective is to investigate how regulatory flexibility and market logic influence the effectiveness of teacher training. The methodology is based on a qualitative approach, consisting of literature review and documentary analysis of the recent regulatory framework, including Law no. 15.388/2026. The results indicate that, although EAD promotes the democratization of access, the predominance of enrollment in the private sector, decoupled from strict regulation and adequate financing, deepens the precariousness of work and teaching identity. It is concluded that the consolidation of distance degrees in the next decade depends on overcoming instrumental rationality, requiring structured policies that link quantitative expansion to professional development and quality standards that ensure the indissociability of theory and pedagogical praxis.

This examined aspects related to academic training, professional context, career challenges, and strategies developed in the daily school environment. title: OS FUNDAMENTOS TEÓRICOS NA PRÁXIS PEDAGÓGICA DO PROFESSOR DE EDUCAÇÃO ESPECIAL THE THEORETICAL FOUNDATIONS IN THE PEDAGOGICAL PRAXIS OF THE SPECIAL EDUCATION TEACHER LOS FUNDAMENTOS TEÓRICOS EN LA PRAXIS PEDAGÓGICA DEL PROFESOR DE EDUCACIÓN ESPECIAL
text_snippet: OS FUNDAMENTOS TEÓRICOS NA PRÁXIS PEDAGÓGICA DO PROFESSOR DE EDUCAÇÃO ESPECIAL THE THEORETICAL FOUNDATIONS IN THE PEDAGOGICAL PRAXIS OF THE SPECIAL EDUCATION TEACHER LOS FUNDAMENTOS TEÓRICOS EN LA PRAXIS PEDAGÓGICA DEL PROFESOR DE EDUCACIÓN ESPECIAL The article aims to discuss the foundations of the pedagogical practice of Special Education teachers, taking praxis as the inseparable unity between theory and practice. The qualitative and exploratory research was conducted with teachers from a municipality in the Greater Vitória/ES region, through open-ended questionnaires administered during in-person continuing education sessions at two different moments, one in 2019 and the other in 2023. The participants have diverse educational backgrounds, predominantly in Pedagogy, with the presence of other teaching degrees. The data reveal different levels of theoretical appropriation, ranging from more systematized references, with emphasis on Historical-Cultural Theory, to understandings that equate legislation, curriculum, immediate demands, or internet searches with a theoretical framework.It is concluded that the consolidation of inclusive practices is linked to teacher education, considering the importance of theoretical foundations that strengthen the realization of the right to learn for students who are the target population of Special Education.

title: CURRICULARIZAÇÃO DA EXTENSÃO E FORMAÇÃO DE PROFESSORES CURRICULIZATION OF EXTENSION ACTIVITIES AND TEACHER EDUCATION CURRICULARIZACIÓN DE LA EXTENSIÓN Y FORMACIÓN DE PROFESORES
text_snippet: CURRICULARIZAÇÃO DA EXTENSÃO E FORMAÇÃO DE PROFESSORES CURRICULIZATION OF EXTENSION ACTIVITIES AND TEACHER EDUCATION CURRICULARIZACIÓN DE LA EXTENSIÓN Y FORMACIÓN DE PROFESORES This article analyzes, within the framework of the curricularization of university extension, the formative, institutional, and community developments of the Articulated Extension Project (PAEX), which addresses the theme of Human Rights Education. The project was implemented in the Pedagogy undergraduate program at São Paulo State University (Unesp), Marília Campus, in 2023. The analysis was conducted considering the contributions of scholars of university extension (Freire, 1992; Tavares, 1997; Nogueira, 2000; Cardoso, 2003; Gadotti, 2017; Gatti, 2019) and of teacher education from the perspective of Human Rights Education (Benevides, 2007; Candau, 2007; Brabo, 2021). This qualitative study was developed through participant observation and analysis of the project's development process. It is concluded that the curricularization of extension through PAEX contributed to the training of pre-service teachers, enabling interaction with the everyday reality of public education, the understanding of principles related to human rights, and the strengthening of university extension committed to the integration of theory and practice.

title: REPRESENTAÇÕES DA BRANQUITUDE NOS LIVROS DIDÁTICOS REPRESENTATIONS OF WHITENESS IN TEXTBOOKS
text_snippet: REPRESENTAÇÕES DA BRANQUITUDE NOS LIVROS DIDÁTICOS REPRESENTATIONS OF WHITENESS IN TEXTBOOKS This article presents the results of a documentary research project aimed at mapping and analyzing academic production on the representation of whiteness in textbooks. The research corpus consists of 11 studies (dissertations and theses) located through the BUSCAd platform. The analysis is based on critical studies of whiteness and the perspective of anti-racist education, seeking to identify investigative trends, theoretical frameworks, analytical categories, and main research results. The findings highlight the recurrence of the centrality of whiteness as a social and racial norm in teaching materials, expressed through visual and textual representations, processes of invisibility and erasure of Black subjects, and the maintenance of symbolic privileges associated with white identity. Although advances resulting from educational policies aimed at promoting racial equality are observed, structures that reproduce racial hierarchies persist in the analyzed materials. The study also reveals a significant gap in research specifically focused on Sociology textbooks, indicating the need to expand investigations in this field.

title: DESENVOLVIMENTO E ANÁLISE DO JOGO “COLOR PUZZLE” COMO RECURSO DE TECNOLOGIA ASSISTIVA NO DESEMPENHO MANIPULATIVO DE ESTUDANTE COM PARALISIA CEREBRAL DEVELOPMENT AND ANALYSIS OF THE GAME “COLOR PUZZLE” AS AN ASSISTIVE TECHNOLOGY RESOURCE IN THE MANIPULATIVE PERFORMANCE OF STUDENT WITH CEREBRAL PALSY
text_snippet: DESENVOLVIMENTO E ANÁLISE DO JOGO “COLOR PUZZLE” COMO RECURSO DE TECNOLOGIA ASSISTIVA NO DESEMPENHO MANIPULATIVO DE ESTUDANTE COM PARALISIA CEREBRAL DEVELOPMENT AND ANALYSIS OF THE GAME “COLOR PUZZLE” AS AN ASSISTIVE TECHNOLOGY RESOURCE IN THE MANIPULATIVE PERFORMANCE OF STUDENT WITH CEREBRAL PALSY Individuals with cerebral palsy may exhibit limitations that impact their daily activities. Assistive Technology plays a pivotal role in the care of individuals with cerebral palsy, as it aims to promote functionality and autonomy. In this context, through a mixed-methods approach (quantitative and qualitative), this study aimed to develop, implement, and analyze the effects of the game “Color Puzzle” on the manipulative skills of a student with cerebral palsy. The “Color Puzzle” stimulates the cognitive and manipulative skills that comprise the evaluated variables, while respecting the participant's specific context. The quantitative analysis was based on relative frequency and Pearson's correlation, which identified a positive and statistically significant correlation for three of the five analyzed variables. Furthermore, the qualitative analysis involved describing the adaptations and teaching strategies employed, based on which the expert judges validated the game “Color Puzzle” as an Assistive Technology.

title: BULLYING E PRECONCEITO ESCOLAR BULLYING AND SCHOOL-BASED PREJUDICE
text_snippet: BULLYING E PRECONCEITO ESCOLAR BULLYING AND SCHOOL-BASED PREJUDICE Addressing persistent problems in society, confronting school violence requires the involvement of the entire community that makes up the school, especially the students. The alliance between university extension and the community presents itself as an effective form of confrontation. From this perspective, the Extension Project "School Hierarchies: confronting bullying and prejudice in the school context" was developed. The objective of this article is to report the lived experience in developing actions aimed at combating bullying and prejudice in the school context. Conversation circles were held between scholarship holders, supervisors, and students from a state school in Feira de Santana, Bahia, about topics surrounding the theme of school violence, such as its relationship with school hierarchies pointed out by Adorno. The activities served as spaces for training, reflection, and possibilities of resistance to manifestations of bullying and prejudice, contributing to the humanization of education and the debate on proposals for confronting and overcoming school violence.

title: APRENDIZAGEM SIGNIFICATIVA EM CIÊNCIAS MEANINGFUL LEARNING IN SCIENCE APRENDIZAJE SIGNIFICATIVO EN CIENCIAS
text_snippet: APRENDIZAGEM SIGNIFICATIVA EM CIÊNCIAS MEANINGFUL LEARNING IN SCIENCE APRENDIZAJE SIGNIFICATIVO EN CIENCIAS This study investigated the perception of 64 1st-year high school students, graduates from elementary school, regarding the process of Meaningful Learning (ML) in Natural Sciences. Based on Ausubel's theory and advances in neuroscience, the objective was to analyze how pedagogical practices and student/teacher attitudes influence ML. The Science Teaching Profile (PEC) instrument, comprising 22 Likert-scale questions, was used, validated by experts with substantial internal consistency (Cronbach's Alpha of 0.74). Results showed a trend of responses in the "Sometimes" scale, indicating heterogeneity in practices fostering ML. Although most ML-favorable processes were present, gaps such as low frequency of experimental activities and post-exam forgetting were identified. It is concluded that teacher training is crucial to promote long-term retention and a critical, reflective graduate profile capable of applying knowledge meaningfully.

title: POÉTICAS DO DESENHO ANIMADO POETICS OF ANIMATION CARTOON

title: A EDUCAÇÃO PARA AS RELAÇÕES ÉTNICO-RACIAIS NOS ANOS INICIAIS EDUCATION FOR ETHNIC-RACIAL RELATIONS IN THE EARLY YEARS OF ELEMENTARY SCHOOL
text_snippet: A EDUCAÇÃO PARA AS RELAÇÕES ÉTNICO-RACIAIS NOS ANOS INICIAIS EDUCATION FOR ETHNIC-RACIAL RELATIONS IN THE EARLY YEARS OF ELEMENTARY SCHOOL By questioning whether textual genres in the Early Years of Elementary Education can be methodologically oriented to promote Education for Ethnic-Racial Relations (ERER), this article develops a theoretical and practical discussion connecting ethnic-racial relations, education, and the teaching of textual genres. From a qualitative perspective, supported by bibliographic research and the implementation of a didactic sequence, it considers the potential of textual genres as a pathway for promoting Education for Ethnic-Racial Relations (ERER). The discussions aimed at deepening this analysis are organized into three stages: reflecting on how ethnic-racial relations manifest themselves in the school context; outlining how the contents of the Portuguese Language curriculum can integrate textual genres with pedagogical practices that enable racial literacy and Afro-literacy; and describing and analyzing the development of anti-racist practices based on an educational experience conducted with two fifth-grade classes in the city of Fortaleza, Ceará, Brazil. title: O PENSAMENTO COMPUTACIONAL E O XADREZ COMPUTATIONAL THINKING AND CHESS
text_snippet: O PENSAMENTO COMPUTACIONAL E O XADREZ COMPUTATIONAL THINKING AND CHESS For this article, a bibliographic review with a qualitative approach was conducted, addressing conceptions of computational thinking, chess, and Mathematics Education. The study is grounded in an expanded understanding of mathematics as a form of thinking and interpreting the world, in dialogue with contemporary transformations associated with digital technologies and algorithmic processes. In this context, computational thinking is understood as a way of organizing reasoning when dealing with complex situations, mobilizing processes such as decomposition, pattern recognition, abstraction, and algorithmization. The investigation was guided by the following question: what conceptions of computational thinking are presented in the literature that relates chess to Mathematics Education? The objective was to analyze these conceptions, identifying their characteristics, theoretical approaches, and didactic implications. Methodologically, the review included national academic publications that discuss computational thinking in the curriculum, the pedagogical use of chess, and the articulations between these fields within Mathematics Education. title: “EU TENTO MOSTRAR PARA OS ALUNOS QUE ELES NÃO TÊM QUE DEPENDER DE ESTADO NENHUM” “I TRY TO SHOW STUDENTS THAT THEY SHOULD NOT DEPEND ON ANY GOVERNMENT”
text_snippet: “EU TENTO MOSTRAR PARA OS ALUNOS QUE ELES NÃO TÊM QUE DEPENDER DE ESTADO NENHUM” “I TRY TO SHOW STUDENTS THAT THEY SHOULD NOT DEPEND ON ANY GOVERNMENT” In recent years, Financial Education has gained increasing prominence in the educational context, particularly following the guidelines established by the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD) in 2005. In Brazil, this movement intensified with the implementation of the National Strategy for Financial Education in 2010 and with the approval of the National Common Curricular Base in 2018. Recent curricular changes have contributed to the formation of subjects aligned with a neoliberal rationality, using Financial Education as a means of disseminating market-oriented and capitalist ideologies. Data were produced through meetings with teachers participating in the project “Formative Pathways and Mathematical Modeling in the New Upper Secondary Education: Perspectives and Practices”, which has been under development since 2023, and were analyzed using a qualitative approach centered on the participants’ voices. title: EQUIDADE RACIAL COMO POLÍTICA EDUCACIONAL
text_snippet: EQUIDADE RACIAL COMO POLÍTICA EDUCACIONAL Nesta pesquisa articulam-se os conceitos de política pública, política educacional e política de equidade racial. Com base neles apresenta-se o Programa Diadema de Dandara e Piatã como política de equidade racial referenciada pelo Movimento Negro e comprometida com a Educação para as Relações Étnico-raciais (ERER). O objetivo do estudo é discutir em que medida as políticas públicas educacionais com enfoque em ERER se concretizam no Programa Dandara e Piatã. A análise volta-se à rede pública de ensino da cidade de Diadema-SP no cumprimento da Lei n° 10.639 (Brasil, 2003), adotando o estudo de caso como estratégia metodológica, com abordagem qualitativa, de caráter bibliográ´fico e documental. Como resultados, o programa não apenas responde a compromissos normativos, mas, atua estrategicamente na consolidação de uma educação orientada pela equidade racial. Sua operacionalização se dá por previsão normativa de funcionamento que evita a dependência da adesão voluntária das unidades escolares e conta com mecanismos de participação social para o acompanhamento contínuo, em uma lógica de democracia participativa. title: APRESENTAÇÃO DO DOSSIÊ
text_snippet: APRESENTAÇÃO DO DOSSIÊ É com satisfação que apresentamos o Dossiê “Curricularização da Extensão na Graduação: aportes teóricos e práticas acadêmicas”, número 1, volume 26, de 2025, organizado no âmbito da revista “Educação em Revista”, da Unesp, Campus Marília. A iniciativa de reunir os trabalhos que compõe esta edição decorre da necessidade de aprofundar os debates sobre a curricularização da extensão, impulsionados pela Resolução CNE/CES n.7 de 2018, do Ministério da Educação, oferecendo subsídios para gestores, formadores e pesquisadores interessados na articulação entre ensino, pesquisa e extensão como princípio formativo. Os trabalhos reunidos abrangem abordagens que consideram dimensões teóricas, históricas, institucionais e práticas da curricularização da extensão.

title: CONVERGÊNCIAS DISCURSIVAS ENTRE AS REFORMAS DO ENSINO MÉDIO E TRABALHISTA DISCURSIVE CONVERGENCES BETWEEN SECONDARY EDUCATION AND LABOR REFORMS CONVERGENCES DISCURSIVAS ENTRE LAS REFORMAS DE LA EDUCACIÓN SECUNDARIA Y LABORAL: NEOLIBERALISMO Y PRECARIZACIÓN
text_snippet: CONVERGÊNCIAS DISCURSIVAS ENTRE AS REFORMAS DO ENSINO MÉDIO E TRABALHISTA DISCURSIVE CONVERGENCES BETWEEN SECONDARY EDUCATION AND LABOR REFORMS CONVERGENCES DISCURSIVAS ENTRE LAS REFORMAS DE LA EDUCACIÓN SECUNDARIA Y LABORAL: NEOLIBERALISMO Y PRECARIZACIÓN This article aims to analyze the convergence between Secondary Education Reforms and Labor Reform, identifying them as expressions of the same neoliberal political-economic project that undermines labor and the right to education from a perspective of integral development. The research is based on a critical documentary and bibliographic analysis, drawing on official documents, academic publications, and literary works. It argues that these reforms, although operating in different spheres, share the logic of flexibilization and the removal of state responsibility, transforming educational vulnerability into a structural condition. However, it is evident that this vulnerability can be reframed as political strength when transformed into critical awareness and collective action. It is concluded that the recognition of this convergence and the articulation between resistance movements constitute a way of confronting the project of commodification of education.

title: FINANCIAMENTO POR RESULTADO NO CEARÁ FINANCING BY RESULTS IN CEARÁ
text_snippet: FINANCIAMENTO POR RESULTADO NO CEARÁ FINANCING BY RESULTS IN CEARÁ In 2020 the Constitutional Amendment N. 108/2020 was approved, sanctioning the New Fundeb. Among some of the new features in the legislation of this Fund is the mandatory division of part of the ICMS for educational improvement, considering certain criteria, including performance in large-scale assessments. The ICMS-education had a pioneer in Brazil, the state of Ceará, with Law N. 14023/2007, which modified the distribution of the ICMS share, based on an educational improvement index. This state is presented in the media as an example of a successful education proposal. The objective of this study was to conduct a bibliographic review of ICMS-education in Ceará, without a time frame, in the BDTD (escreve em pt, não traduz) and Google Scholar, using the search terms "ICMS-educação" and "Ceará" between november 2023 and december of the same year. The results obtained were analyzed quantitatively, revealing that most of the theses and dissertations are in the area of ​​economics and not education and that such research contributes to improving educational performance indicators after the implementation of the legislation

title: REDUÇÃO DE DANOS HARM REDUCTION Reducción de daños: estrategias de extensión para la difusión horizontal de conocimientos sobre sustancias psicoactivas
text_snippet: REDUÇÃO DE DANOS HARM REDUCTION Reducción de daños: estrategias de extensión para la difusión horizontal de conocimientos sobre sustancias psicoactivas The use of psychoactive substances is present in different political and socio-cultural contexts. The harm reduction can be a strategy that can prevent its abuse and provide solutions that validate the autonomy of individuals. Thus, less formal proposals for teaching, but which prioritize drug education, forms of consumption and harm reduction methods were used through different pedagogical paths to bring participants closer to the themes, creating learning environments and helping them to make autonomous decisions, generating a better relationship between drugs and society. The extension activities carried out addressed the use and abuse of marijuana, alcohol, nicotine and LSD through films, emotionally immersing viewers in the subject; in lectures, exposing technical and scientific information on mechanisms of action and social factors; and in conversation circles, bringing proximity to the exchange of information, establishing a horizontal dispersion of knowledge. This highlights the importance of tackling the issue of psychoactive drugs, which is neglected in the face of national policies and can be worked on in extension activities, reaching places that are difficult to access

title: “CINEMA NA EDUCAÇÃO”
text_snippet: “CINEMA NA EDUCAÇÃO” Objetivou-se por meio deste artigo apresentar um relato de experiência com produção de vídeos estudantis realizada em sala de aula pelo professor de Ciências e Tecnologia com estudantes do ensino fundamental de dois colégios públicos. O primeiro localizado em zona rural e o segundo em zona urbana, respectivamente nos estados da Bahia e São Paulo. Essa experiência de produção de vídeo estudantil foi utilizada como um recurso pedagógico para desenvolver a autonomia dos estudantes com seu processo de aprendizagem. O vídeo produzido durante a execução do projeto didático foi destinado ao projeto de vídeos estudantis em ambas instituições. Os resultados deste estudo revelam que a produção audiovisual em contextos escolares oferece uma metodologia de ensino significativa para o desenvolvimento integral dos estudantes, promovendo competências cognitivas, emocionais e sociais.

title: AVALIAR É PUNIR? O PAPEL DO DIRETOR ESCOLAR A PARTIR DA IMPLEMENTAÇÃO DA LEI Nº 18.221/2024 NO MUNICÍPIO DE SÃO PAULO IS TO ASSESS TO PUNISH? O PAPEL DO DIRETOR ESCOLAR A PARTIR DA IMPLEMENTAÇÃO DA LEI Nº 18.221/2024 NO MUNICÍPIO DE SÃO PAULO.

O PAPEL DO DIRETOR ESCOLAR A PARTIR DA IMPLEMENTAÇÃO DA LEI Nº 18.221/2024 NO MUNICÍPIO DE SÃO PAULO. This article analyzes the impacts of Law No. 18.221/2024, which introduces significant changes to Law No. 8.989 of October 29, 1979, governing the statute of public servants in the Municipality of São Paulo. Based on this legislation, it examines the redefinition of the role of school principals within the municipal education system. Through documentary analysis and bibliographic research, the study discusses the advancement of individual accountability and meritocracy logics, in contrast with the principles of democratic management and formative assessment. The evidence points to the strengthening of control mechanisms that undermine the emancipatory nature of public education

title: DA HEGEMONIA COLONIAL À HEGEMONIA GLOBAL FROM COLONIAL HEGEMONY TO GLOBAL HEGEMONY De la Hegemonía Colonial a la Hegemonía Global: Un Análisis Histórico-Crítico de las Influencias de las Organizaciones Internacionales en las Políticas de Formación Docente en Mozambique y Brasil
text_snippet: DA HEGEMONIA COLONIAL À HEGEMONIA GLOBAL FROM COLONIAL HEGEMONY TO GLOBAL HEGEMONY De la Hegemonía Colonial a la Hegemonía Global: Un Análisis Histórico-Crítico de las Influencias de las Organizaciones Internacionales en las Políticas de Formación Docente en Mozambique y Brasil This article analyzes the influence of international organizations on teacher training policies in Mozambique and Brazil, highlighting the transition from colonial hegemony to global hegemony in education. Based on a historical-critical perspective, grounded in authors such as Antunes (2009), Giareta (2021), Gramsci (1968; 1982), and Neves (2005), it discusses how organizations such as the World Bank, UNESCO, and OECD act as private apparatuses of hegemony, promoting policies aligned with neoliberal logic, curriculum standardization, and result measurement. The study is organized into three main axes: historical continuities and reconfigurations of power in education; mediations of international organizations in teacher training; and a comparative analysis between Mozambique and Brazil, emphasizing the tension between global dependence and the pursuit of emancipatory education. The results reveal that, although the discourses of “quality” and “modernization” are recurrent, international policies often reinforce epistemological and pedagogical subordination, restricting teacher autonomy and the critical r

title: “GUIA DE OBRAS DE LITERATURA PARA O ENSINO FUNDAMENTAL II” E INDÚSTRIA CULTURAL “GUIDE TO LITERATURE WORKS FOR MIDDLE SCHOOL” AND CULTURE INDUSTRY
text_snippet: “GUIA DE OBRAS DE LITERATURA PARA O ENSINO FUNDAMENTAL II” E INDÚSTRIA CULTURAL “GUIDE TO LITERATURE WORKS FOR MIDDLE SCHOOL” AND CULTURE INDUSTRY This qualitative and bibliographic research is aimed at briefly presenting the “Guide to Literary Works for Middle School”, an educational product developed as a possible suggestion for teachers facing the challenging task of selecting literary books for Middle School students. Given the growing number of available titles in Children's and Young Adult Literature - market niches in continuous expansion - this task becomes increasingly difficult and inevitably leads to the concept of the Culture Industry. The reflections proposed throughout this text aim to respond whether the Guide, within this context, represents a potential rupture or the inescapable continuation of current trends. Thus, Literature, reader development, literary literacy - serving as theoretical foundations for the product - along with the Culture Industry, Mass Culture, and generative themes, are addressed in different sections of the study, which concludes that we may be facing a possible rupture, depending on the understanding of both the developers and the teachers who will use the product.

title: O ESTUDANTE NEGRO NA EDUCAÇÃO ESPECIAL THE BLACK STUDENT IN SPECIAL EDUCATION
text_snippet: O ESTUDANTE NEGRO NA EDUCAÇÃO ESPECIAL THE BLACK STUDENT IN SPECIAL EDUCATION This article analyzes the historical and social trajectory of Black students served by Special Education, highlighting how racism, discrimination, and prejudice intersect within the Brazilian school context. Its main objective is to understand the political, social, and educational factors that have perpetuated the exclusion and invisibility of Black and Brown people with disabilities, disorders, high abilities, and giftedness, as well as to investigate the impact of racism and medical and scientific practices on the denial of their educational rights. This qualitative study is based on a literature review and an analysis of national legislation, which made it possible to identify the persistence of structural and cultural barriers. The results reveal that, even after legal advances, the Black population with disabilities continues to face structural racism, ableism, and a lack of effective public policies. The study concludes that only the implementation of antiracist policies, affirmative actions, and inclusive schooling can guarantee equitable access, retention, and learning for all students, overcoming long-standing practices of exclusion and marginalization.

title: A RELAÇÃO PROFESSOR-ALUNO PÓS-PANDEMIA EM INSTITUIÇÕES DE ENSINO SUPERIOR
text_snippet: A RELAÇÃO PROFESSOR-ALUNO PÓS-PANDEMIA EM INSTITUIÇÕES DE ENSINO SUPERIOR A relação professor-aluno é fundamental no processo de ensino e aprendizagem e foi significativamente impactada pela pandemia de COVID-19, especialmente em função do ensino remoto e das mudanças nas interações pedagógicas. Este estudo teve como objetivo analisar as percepções de alunos e professores acerca das transformações ocorridas nessa relação pós-pandemia no ensino superior. Trata-se de uma pesquisa exploratória realizada com 78 alunos de graduação e 19 docentes de quatro instituições do Vale do Paraíba, por meio de questionários online contendo questões em escala Likert (1 a 5), múltipla escolha e perguntas discursivas. Os dados foram analisados por estatística descritiva e categorização qualitativa das respostas abertas. Os resultados indicaram que 62% dos alunos e 83% dos professores avaliavam a relação como boa ou muito boa antes da pandemia; no período pós-pandêmico, esse percentual reduziu para 46% entre os alunos, enquanto 68% dos docentes mantiveram avaliação positiva. A desmotivação discente foi apontada como principal fator influenciador da relação atual (64% dos alunos e 68% dos professores). title: OS DESAFIOS DO PROCESSO DE ENSINO E APRENDIZAGEM DOS ESTUDANTES CONSIDERADOS COM DEFICIÊNCIA NO ENSINO MÉDIO THE CHALLENGES OF THE TEACHING AND LEARNING PROCESS OF STUDENTS CONSIDERED WITH DISABILITIES IN HIGH SCHOOL
text_snippet: OS DESAFIOS DO PROCESSO DE ENSINO E APRENDIZAGEM DOS ESTUDANTES CONSIDERADOS COM DEFICIÊNCIA NO ENSINO MÉDIO THE CHALLENGES OF THE TEACHING AND LEARNING PROCESS OF STUDENTS CONSIDERED WITH DISABILITIES IN HIGH SCHOOL This work aims to promote reflection on the challenges of teaching and learning for students who present difficulties, especially in reading, writing and abstractions, gaps that arise from possible health problems, emotional and physical disorders, family friction, or even lack of stimulus, social inequality, among others. The reflection was based on methodological analyzes and recovery of the gap of students considered to have disabilities in high school, observed with the aim of considering the importance of teacher training and the problems faced daily in the school environment, based on theoretical references and reports of practices and successful methods applied by teachers from a full-time state school in a city in the interior of the State of São Paulo.

title: ENSINO DE PRODUÇÃO DE CONTO DE AVENTURA TEACHING ADVENTURE STORY PRODUCTION
text_snippet: ENSINO DE PRODUÇÃO DE CONTO DE AVENTURA TEACHING ADVENTURE STORY PRODUCTION This intervention research analyzed the teaching knowledge of three teachers who implemented a teaching sequence in their respective classes in 2019, after participating in a training course on literature and teaching adventure story production between the 3rd and 5th grades of elementary school. They commented on the impact of the activity at three specific moments: before implementing the teaching sequence; after the 8th activity in the sequence; and after the last activity in the sequence. The interviews were analyzed according to Bardin (1977) and supplemented with a logbook. The two years of continuing education supported the development of knowledge, such as: Geraldi's (2011) conception of language; Antunes' (2003) teacher researcher profile, involving teaching practices that considered the dimensions of Moretto (2003) and Becker (1993); and the organization of the learning project from the perspective of Jolibert et al (1994), in addition to becoming teachers who produce adventure stories.

title: CURRICULARIZAÇÃO DA EXTENSÃO EXTENSION CURRICULUM
text_snippet: CURRICULARIZAÇÃO DA EXTENSÃO EXTENSION CURRICULUM The activity involved the extension curriculum carried out in the discipline of Molecular Genetics of the Pharmacy Course of the Regional Integrated University of Alto Uruguai and Missions – URI/Santiago in partnership with the school of the same institution and with the São João pharmacy. It aimed to alert the school community about the importance of prostate exams, promoting citizenship and health promotion in the surroundings of the school. It was held during Blue November, involved 37 students from the school and 6 university students. The students produced cards, printed them and talked to men and women about prostate cancer; the university students reinforced the subject and performed blood glucose tests and blood pressure checks. The receptivity of the community, the stigmas in relation to the theme, the involvement of students, the exchange of knowledge and the opportunity to promote health were observed. It is concluded that the curriculum brings the opportunity for the academic curriculum to be shared with the community. title: AS NOVAS TECNOLOGIAS DIGITAIS NOS CAMPOS AVALIATIVOS E METODOLÓGICOS PARA AS FORMAÇÕES CONTINUADAS DE PROFESSORES DE MATEMÁTICA THE NEW DIGITAL TECHNOLOGIES IN THE EVALUATIVE AND METHODOLOGICAL FIELDS FOR THE CONTINUING EDUCATION OF MATHEMATICS TEACHERS
text_snippet: AS NOVAS TECNOLOGIAS DIGITAIS NOS CAMPOS AVALIATIVOS E METODOLÓGICOS PARA AS FORMAÇÕES CONTINUADAS DE PROFESSORES DE MATEMÁTICA THE NEW DIGITAL TECHNOLOGIES IN THE EVALUATIVE AND METHODOLOGICAL FIELDS FOR THE CONTINUING EDUCATION OF MATHEMATICS TEACHERS Today's education has been marked by a dynamic and complex scenario, where technology plays a central role in pedagogical practices and access to information. In view of this, there is a need to update the teacher so that he adopts strategies appropriate to the new technological context of the students and, with that, make the classes more dynamic and attractive. Thus, the objective of this work is to propose a methodology for evaluations in mathematics and the creation of tutorial materials that guide the teacher in their pedagogical practices. Through a theoretical foundation study, we developed two tutorial e-books, the first "Digital Assessment Constructions" and the second "Scape Room Constructions". As a result, we highlight that the material produced was considered effective by the group of 21 teachers, coordinators and principals and proved to be a possible alternative to be applied by professionals who wish to use technologies to promote active learning. In addition, the tutorials helped professionals in the use of technological tools, becoming an ally in the process of continuing education.

title: ASPECTOS PEDAGÓGICOS RELACIONADOS À UTILIZAÇÃO DAS HISTÓRIAS EM QUADRINHOS/TIRINHAS ADAPTADAS PARA ALUNOS CEGOS PEDAGOGICAL ASPECTS RELATED TO THE USE OF COMIC STORIES/COMIC STRIPS ADAPTED FOR BLIND STUDENTS
text_snippet: ASPECTOS PEDAGÓGICOS RELACIONADOS À UTILIZAÇÃO DAS HISTÓRIAS EM QUADRINHOS/TIRINHAS ADAPTADAS PARA ALUNOS CEGOS PEDAGOGICAL ASPECTS RELATED TO THE USE OF COMIC STORIES/COMIC STRIPS ADAPTED FOR BLIND STUDENTS This paper presents the pedagogical aspects of the use of comic books (HQ) as a textual genre that awakens creativity and playfulness in the classroom and the possibilities of interdisciplinary work through its use for pedagogical purposes. The Brazilian Law for the Inclusion of Persons with Disabilities, Law 13.146/15, which guarantees the Braille System as an educational resource, demonstrates some physical resources used by blind students to read and write the Braille code and how the visual code of comic books is made accessible to these students. Based on documentary research with a qualitative approach, the results are presented through examples and reflections on the accessibility of the visual code, which uses the Braille code as a reading medium to make the description of the images accessible to the student who cannot see. title: A PRECARIZAÇÃO DO TRABALHO DE ADOLESCENTES ENTREGADORES DE APLICATIVOS EM TEMPOS DE PANDEMIA E SUAS CONSEQUÊNCIAS THE PRECARIOUS WORK OF ADOLESCENT APPLICATION DELIVERY IN TIMES OF PANDEMIC AND ITS CONSEQUENCES LA PRECARIEDAD DEL TRABAJO DE LOS REPARTIDORES ADOLESCENTES DE PAAdolescente
text_snippet: A PRECARIZAÇÃO DO TRABALHO DE ADOLESCENTES ENTREGADORES DE APLICATIVOS EM TEMPOS DE PANDEMIA E SUAS CONSEQUÊNCIAS THE PRECARIOUS WORK OF ADOLESCENT APPLICATION DELIVERY IN TIMES OF PANDEMIC AND ITS CONSEQUENCES LA PRECARIEDAD DEL TRABAJO DE LOS REPARTIDORES ADOLESCENTES DE PAAdolescente This study aims to analyze the consequences of the precarious work of teenagers who deliver apps during the Covid-19 pandemic in Brazil. As a design, the essay was chosen, which is a critical and interpretive text, from which we sought to answer the following question: What are the consequences of the precarious work of teenagers who deliver apps in times of a pandemic? To this end, the article was divided into three parts. First, it presents the definition of digital work, precarious work and its relationship with capitalism. Then, it provides a debate about the uberization of work and adolescence in the Brazilian context. And, finally, the consequences of precarious work in adolescence, including the impacts of the Covid-19 pandemic on the work of delivery people by application. As final considerations, the study demonstrated the impacts on adolescent health, education and professionalization, with future consequences, creating enormous barriers to entering the formal job market or changing jobs, and exacerbating the socio-racial inequalities that exist in the country.

title: CONSELHOS DE CLASSE COMO ESPAÇO DE FORMAÇÃO HUMANA INTEGRAL CLASS COUNCILS AS A SPACE FOR HOLISTIC HUMAN DEVELOPMENT
text_snippet: CONSELHOS DE CLASSE COMO ESPAÇO DE FORMAÇÃO HUMANA INTEGRAL CLASS COUNCILS AS A SPACE FOR HOLISTIC HUMAN DEVELOPMENT This study is the result of exploratory research aimed at identifying the possibilities and challenges inherent to Class Councils as spaces for comprehensive human development from the perspective of Professional and Technological Education (PTE). To this end, it focused on the analysis of master's dissertations produced within the scope of Professional and Technological Education graduate programs. The selection of the works analyzed was based on searches in the CAPES Theses and Dissertations Catalog and the ProfEPT Observatory's database of dissertations and educational products, using the methodology of the state of knowledge. For data analysis, Bardin's (2016) content analysis method was employed. The study identified the potential of this collegiate body as a space for comprehensive human development from two perspectives: as a mechanism that drives the school’s pedagogical actions and as a space for democratic participation and political education. Among the challenges, the research identified the perception among teachers of the Class Council as a space for judgment, and secondly, the difficulty of this space being effectively established as an instance of full participation

title: UM DIÁLOGO SOBRE O MÉTODO MONTESSORI E SEU USO NO BRASIL E NA AUSTRÁLIA A DIALOGUE ABOUT THE MONTESSORI METHOD AND ITS USE IN BRAZIL AND AUSTRALIA
text_snippet: UM DIÁLOGO SOBRE O MÉTODO MONTESSORI E SEU USO NO BRASIL E NA AUSTRÁLIA A DIALOGUE ABOUT THE MONTESSORI METHOD AND ITS USE IN BRAZIL AND AUSTRALIA Esse trabalho analisa o método Montessori que oferece um sistema educacional inovador criado e desenvolvido por Maria Montessori no início do século XX, a partir de suas observações e estudos sobre o comportamento e aprendizado infantil quando trabalhava em uma clínica psiquiátrica com crianças com necessidades especiais. Maria enfatiza a importância do ambiente preparado, da liberdade com responsabilidade e do papel do educador como guia. Posteriormente, o trabalho tratou sobre a incorporação e aplicação desse método em escolas no Brasil e na Austrália. Nos resultados, foi possível verificar que ao longo das últimas décadas, o interesse por abordagens pedagógicas alternativas cresceu significativamente, levando sua expansão em diversos países, notadamente com os dados verificou que a implementação no Brasil se deu em menor escala comparado com a Austrália, que tem uma tradição mais consolidada de escolas alternativas. Concluiu se que o método Montessori encontrou um terreno fértil para seu desenvolvimento na Austrália, contudo no Brasil ainda não tem muitos adeptos. A metodologia utilizada foi o método bibliográfico e qualitativo, com revisão de literatura existente sobre o método

title: A CURRICULARIZAÇÃO DA EXTENSÃO NOS CURSOS DE LICENCIATURA THE CURRICULARIZATION OF EXTENSION IN LICENCIATURA PROGRAMS
text_snippet: A CURRICULARIZAÇÃO DA EXTENSÃO NOS CURSOS DE LICENCIATURA THE CURRICULARIZATION OF EXTENSION IN LICENCIATURA PROGRAMS The article aims to investigate the integration of extension curricularization in teacher education, specifically within the Bachelor’s Degree in Chemistry program at the Federal University of Santa Catarina – Blumenau Campus. The methodology adopted is based on a qualitative perspective, utilizing a case study approach and content analysis. The research corpus comprised the Political-Pedagogical Project (PPP) and the Teaching Programs (TP) of the course's subjects. The analysis of extension curricularization in these documents engaged with the Dimensions of the Field of Didactics, which include Foundations, External Conditions, Internal Conditions, and Methods of the teaching process. The main findings reveal that, although theory and practice are valued in the TPs, there are significant gaps in their articulation with extension activities, particularly in disciplines that do not explicitly address the contribution of extension to teacher education. The analysis highlights that integrating theory and practice is essential for fostering critical and reflective teacher training. The conclusions indicate that extension curricularization must be explicitly incorporated into curricular

title: ANAFALBETISMOS SOCIAIS SOCIAL ILLITULTIES
text_snippet: ANAFALBETISMOS SOCIAIS SOCIAL ILLITULTIES ABSTRACT: Education is fundamental for human and social development, yet the persistence of social illiteracy signals that it is not receiving the attention it deserves in our society. Therefore, this article, based on diverse bibliographical research, sought to present facts that highlight the importance of education for society and the ills caused by its neglect. Throughout this article, there is a rich exposition that proves the existence of numerous social problems caused directly and indirectly by poor education. Finally, it is concluded that education must ensure that individuals have critical thinking and a leading role in the pursuit of knowledge. Education focused on literacy and addressing numerous topics in the classroom is necessary. This requires, above all, state investment to guarantee quality education, especially regarding teachers, who, despite being seen as the pillars of education, require the support of families in the educational process.

title: JOGOS VIRTUAIS COMO EXPERIÊNCIA PEDAGÓGICA NO ENSINO DE FILOSOFIA VIRTUAL GAMES AS A PEDAGOGICAL EXPERIENCE IN PHILOSOPHY TEACHING
text_snippet: JOGOS VIRTUAIS COMO EXPERIÊNCIA PEDAGÓGICA NO ENSINO DE FILOSOFIA VIRTUAL GAMES AS A PEDAGOGICAL EXPERIENCE IN PHILOSOPHY TEACHING This qualitative study, grounded in contemporary philosophical and methodological frameworks, explores the use of video games in Philosophy teaching, understanding them as symbolic artifacts embedded in digital culture. The analysis emphasizes playfulness as an educational vector, fostering critical and ethical thinking through interactive digital language. Rejecting superficial techno-enthusiasm, the paper performs a hermeneutic reading of the aesthetics and narratives of complex games. By focusing on narratively rich titles, it repositions philosophical practice within ludic territories, bridging traditional knowledge with emerging languages. The methodological approach rejects outdated pedagogical models, advocating for active mediation between digital culture and conceptual formation. Consequently, it outlines a field of didactic-philosophical experimentation attentive to students’ cognitive, emotional, and social experiences in times of techno-globalization.
